question: What claim is being made about the even-wise one who is burning, in relation to nectar-tip and juice-tip?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of juice as an instrument.
The even-wise one, though burning, is the subject of the claim.
inference: Even the even-wise one, while burning by means of the tip of juice at the tip of nectar, remains the subject of this claim.
uncertainties: The outcome for the even-wise one is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of juice, even the even-wise one, though burning, remains.
